spavin.definition: n a swelling of the hock joint of a horse; resulting in lameness

spavined.definition: s. (of horses) afflicted with a swelling of the hock-joint
spavined.translation:
a. 跛的, 残废的
[医] 患飞节内肿的

spavins.definition:
plural of spavin
n a swelling of the hock joint of a horse; resulting in lameness
spavins.translation: (spavin 的复数) n.(马的)跗节内肿
